beats.say: Your favourite Netflix rom-com just dropped its third season today.
Season three premiered on 22 October 2026, ready to stream now for binge-watchers.
Created by Erin Foster, the series began on 26 September 2024 with Kristen Bell and Adam Brody leading the love story.
After a November 2025 renewal, fans finally get fresh romance and new twists.
Which couple’s chemistry are you most excited to watch this weekend?

facts: Nobody Wants This season three premieres on October 22, 2026

Nobody Wants This is an American romantic comedy television series created by Erin Foster which premiered on Netflix on September 26 2024 and stars Kristen Bell, Adam Brody, Justine Lupe, Timothy Simons and Jackie Tohn
In November 2025, the series was renewed for a third season which premiered on October 22, 2026
